messages.subject: Redwood — tenant authority letters and rent deposit deed
messages.plaintextBody:
Elena,

Ahead of completion, attaching is not needed but for the file: we've engrossed the four tenant authority letters (directing rents to the buyer) and the deed of assignment of the Mercer Wells rent deposit in the agreed form. The seller will hand these over on completion. Please confirm you're content with the form of the deposit assignment.

Nadia
